events.name: New Orleans Pelicans at Oklahoma City Thunder

headlines.description: — Shai Gilgeous-Alexander had 30 points and seven assists in three quarters, and the Oklahoma City Thunder defeated the New Orleans Pelicans 137-106 on Sunday to extend their season-opening winning streak to seven games.
headlines.shortLinkText: Gilgeous-Alexander scores 30 points to help keep Thunder unbeaten, Pelicans winless

headlines.description: — Kelly Oubre Jr. scored 29 points, Tyrese Maxey had 26, and the Philadelphia 76ers defeated the Brooklyn Nets 129-105 on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kelly Oubre Jr. scores 29 points as 76ers defeat Nets 129-105

headlines.description: — Miles Bridges scored 29 points, Kon Knueppel added a career-high 24 and the Charlotte Hornets routed the Utah Jazz 126-103 on Sunday night to snap a three-game losing streak.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kon Knueppel's career-high 24 points helps Hornets to a 126-103 rout of Jazz

headlines.description: — Donovan Mitchell made eight 3-pointers and scored a season-high 37 points in his return to Cleveland's lineup, leading the Cavaliers to a 117-109 win on Sunday night over the Atlanta Hawks, who are navigating the early season without injured star...
headlines.shortLinkText: Donovan Mitchell scores 37 points as Cavaliers down Young-less Hawks 117-109

headlines.description: — RJ Barrett scored 27 points, Brandon Ingram added 26 and the Toronto Raptors won consecutive games for the first time this season by beating the short-handed Memphis Grizzlies 117-104 on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: RJ Barrett scores 27 as Raptors beat Grizzlies 117-104 for first back-to-back wins

events.name: Chicago Bulls at New York Knicks

headlines.description: — Jalen Brunson scored 31 points as the New York Knicks snapped a three-game losing streak and handed the Chicago Bulls their first loss of the season, 128-116 on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brunson scores 31 as Knicks snap losing streak, hand Bulls first loss

events.name: San Antonio Spurs at Phoenix Suns

headlines.description: — Devin Booker scored 28 points, Grayson Allen and Ryan Dunn each added 17 and the hot-shooting Phoenix Suns handed Victor Wembanyama and the San Antonio Spurs their first loss, 130-118 on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Booker scores 28 and Wembanyama has off night as Suns hand Spurs their first loss, 130-118

events.name: Miami Heat at Los Angeles Lakers

headlines.description: — Luka Doncic had 29 points, 11 rebounds and 10 assists, Austin Reaves scored 26 points, and the Los Angeles Lakers beat the Miami Heat 130-120 on Sunday night to extend their winning streak to three games.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lakers beat Heat 130-120 behind Doncic's triple-double
